messages.text:
Most people don't — the average US rate is around 12¢/kWh, so a Thor P2 runs you a few dollars a month. It's $369, 10 TH/s, drawing for a full block every ten minutes.

Is this your first miner?
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page

At 12¢/kWh the Thor P2 stacks about 14,300 sats a month (~$11.90 today) and costs $14.53 in power. 166 W, ~40 dB, so it sits on a desk. Jackpot odds on a full block: roughly 0.06% over a year.

Since you're already mining, the B30 at $899 triples that — 42,900 sats a month, 0.17% a year. Which way are you leaning?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Hammer Miner Thor P2 numbers for where you live.
